technical.summary: GM shows bullish intermediate structure (9/21/50 EMA alignment) with strong momentum confirmation (OBV, supertrend, CMF), but lacks long-term uptrend confirmation and faces headwind from 200-period resistance; suitable for swing entry with defined risk above 200-SMA.

fundamental.summary: GM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 40 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-like 20 score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with only junior member mixed trades 90+ days old, and absent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (306.4), rising dollar headwind, and recent CPI miss creating recession risk; 40-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate EMA alignment (9/21/50), supertrend bullish, OBV divergence, and extreme fear sentiment create a contrarian swing entry opportunity with defined risk above 200-SMA.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely deteriorated (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, DXY headwind, recession risk), price remains below 200-EMA/SMA, MACD rolling over, and 40-day earnings event risk outweigh technical strength in a risk-off regime.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows intermediate bullish structure (9/21/50 EMA alignment, supertrend, OBV divergence) with contrarian opportunity in extreme fear; however, macro deterioration and earnings proximity do not justify new exposure.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, and recession risk create severe macro headwinds that override technical strength; 40-day earnings event adds uncompensated timing risk.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents bullish, fundamental/risk/sentiment agents bearish; debate winner (bear) reflects macro dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding GM position with 37 existing Consumer Discretionary positions (20% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further.
